artworks.title: Large Farm with Draw Well
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a rustic village scene with thatched-roof buildings, surrounded by trees. The point of view is straight-on, with a low horizon line. The etching employs detailed line work to emphasize texture and form. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and gray. Two birds are seen flying in the sky. The trees vary in height and depth in the composition.

artworks.title: Farms
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with thatched houses, trees, figures walking, livestock and a cart. The composition features fine brushstrokes and detailed textures, using a monochrome palette with strong contrasts of light and shadow. A couple of figures are walking, one carrying a jug or pot, while cattle are present. Thatched houses and trees line the horizon, with a distant cart and more trees visible. The sky above has light clouds and birds in flight, adding motion to the scene.

artworks.title: Farms with Draw Well
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image features a rural scene. The perspective is slightly elevated, showing a landscape with open skies, sparse clouds, and a few birds. The intricate etching depicts textures of trees, buildings, and earth with fine cross-hatching. The monochromatic color palette emphasizes light and shadow contrast. In the foreground, people are engaged with barrels and ducks. Beyond them are thatched-roof buildings and bare trees, including a large tree with sprawling branches. In the background, more trees are scattered throughout.

artworks.title: Town Gate with Country Houses
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape in a detailed etching style, featuring a historical town. A dirt path curves beside a body of water with swans. A woman with two children and a dog walk along the path. A grand cylindrical tower with turrets stands out on the right, with other medieval buildings around. Buildings stretch into the distance, leading to a bridge archway. The sky has fine horizontal brushstrokes, appearing clear with birds in flight. The monochrome palette emphasizes architectural details and a serene ambiance.

artworks.title: Farm
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with grazing animals and farm structures. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, offering a view of the landscape. Thatched cottages, trees, and animals are depicted with clear, fine lines showing textures and shadows. The scene is in monochromatic tones of grey achieved through hatching. Cows are lounging in a field with figures present, and mature trees line the background. The sky has wispy clouds, contrasting with the serene landscape.

artworks.title: Shed with Cottage
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes

artworks.title: Country Houses
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a countryside setting from an elevated point of view. Trees, rural structures, people on a pathway, thatched roof houses, fields, hedgerows, birds, and a clear sky are depicted in fine, detailed etching. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones.

artworks.title: Farm with Shed and Draw Well
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with a slightly elevated viewpoint. A tree line marks the horizon, with a dirt pathway in the foreground where two people are walking. Logs and sparse vegetation are on the left, and on the right, the pathway slopes upward toward a rustic settlement with thatched roofs and wooden buildings nestled among trees. Delicate brushstrokes create texture in the branches. The monochrome palette emphasizes the detailed line work. Additional figures are seen in the distance, blending with the surroundings. The scene conveys a tranquil countryside atmosphere with its naturalistic details and composed layout.

artworks.title: Farms in a Court
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with a farmstead. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, looking down at the scene. The horizon is high in the image, with rooftops, trees, fine lines capturing texture and shading in black and white. The color palette is monochrome, focusing on light and shadow contrasts. Figures and horses are shown in motion across an open space, with detailed etching. A farmhouse and outbuildings with varied roofs are behind them. Trees flank the buildings, adding vertical elements against the horizontal lines etched in the sky. In the distance, details fade into simplicity against a clearer sky.

artworks.title: Farm with Gateway
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image displays a rural scene from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is positioned around one-third from the top, with leafless trees forming a silhouette against the sky. In the distance, there are simple structures clustered along a dirt path, with people and birds present. The artwork utilizes intricate etching techniques, featuring detailed linear strokes to delineate trees, clouds, and the ground, creating a textured appearance. The color scheme consists of various shades of grey, common in etching, set against the light hue of the paper. The artwork highlights the fine details of the rural environment through subtle contrasts.

artworks.title: Farms
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a village setting. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing a wide expanse with the horizon marked by trees and rooftops. Figures are visible, including people walking and working. In the distance, traditional village houses with thatched roofs can be seen. The style features detailed linework typical of etching, with a monochromatic color palette of black and white. The sky has swirling clouds and a few birds in flight.

artworks.title: Country Village with Church Tower
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a wide view of the area. The horizon is in the upper third of the image, with thatched-roof cottages, a spired church, and various trees along it. The scene is detailed with precise lines and a black and white palette for contrast and shadows. In the foreground, two women are walking, a dog is running, and a horse rider is present. In the distance, trees and buildings populate the landscape, creating a village setting.

artworks.title: Country Village with Church
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a broad view over a serene landscape. Trees obscure the horizon, with rustic buildings and tall, leafy trees in the background. Detailed line work and cross-hatching techniques create a realistic portrayal of the scene. The color palette is monochrome, resembling black and white etching. A figure tends to cattle while ducks float in a pond. Another figure is resting on the ground. The overall impression is of a peaceful rural environment.

artworks.title: Farms
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a village scene. The horizon is near the upper third of the composition. Birds are flying on the right side. The artwork features detailed brushstrokes or etch lines, capturing architectural and natural elements. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white. In the foreground, two figures walk along a path, while a person fishes in a pond with ducks swimming. In the background, there is a stone building with a towering chimney, along with thatched-roof houses, hills, and sparse trees.

artworks.title: Farms
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image displays a pastoral scene with a cluster of thatched-roof cottages along the horizon. Sparse trees surround the cottages. The brushwork is detailed and precise, capturing textures in the rooftops and landscape with fine lines. The color palette is mostly sepia or brown. A small pond with grass at its edge is in the foreground, with livestock like cows and sheep and figures further in the distance. The sky has scattered clouds and a flock of birds.

artworks.title: Farms
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with thatched-roof structures, trees, sky with clouds and birds in flight. The artwork features fine, detailed hatching and cross-hatching. The color scheme is monochromatic with varying shades of black ink on cream-colored paper. A lone figure with a stick is walking near chickens pecking around. Thatched structures are seen in the distance, completing the scene.

artworks.title: Road with Barn and Cottages
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with leafless trees, a path with small figures, cottages, and dense foliage on both sides. The fine, detailed etching technique highlights textures like thatch, foliage, and tree bark. The monochrome color palette creates a timeless aesthetic, emphasizing texture and form. The sky is neutral, enhancing the landscape's details.

artworks.title: Farms and Shed
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural village scene from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is high in the composition, almost level with the roofs of the houses. Delicate lines depict detailed textures of thatched roofs and trees. The monochromatic color scheme features various shades of black and white. A cart with figures is seen on a path, leading towards more trees, houses, and figures. Further ahead, a person on horseback and others are visible. In the distance, rustic houses with thatched roofs and bare trees portray a tranquil village setting.

artworks.title: Village Road with Farm and Sheds
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape with buildings, trees, and a dirt road. The horizon is obscured by the structures and tall trees. There are people along the road, including a child with a dog and a woman with children. The artwork shows detailed etchings with wispy brushstrokes, in a monochromatic color palette of gray and black.

artworks.title: Village Road
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a landscape and village scene. The horizon line is high, with trees, rooftops, and distant structures depicted in simple, linear detail. The etching technique is seen in the fine lines defining the trees, buildings, and figures. Close to the viewer, people and animals are gathered on a path, with some appearing to converse or rest. In the background, houses with thatched roofs are surrounded by trees. The color palette is monochrome, with varying shades to create contrast and depth in the scene.

artworks.title: A Farmyard with a Draw Well
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The composition includes buildings, trees, and a horizon. The art style is detailed and expressive, with fine line work capturing textures. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing depth and form. The scene includes buildings with thatched roofs, trees, and a group of chickens. In the distance, more buildings and trees are visible, creating a small village in nature.

artworks.title: Farm and Row of Houses
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing two thatched cottages with figures engaged in various activities nearby. The horizon is softly indicated by lighter etching strokes in the sky, with scattered clouds. The scene has a rustic setting with a simple, monochromatic color palette of black ink on a light background. Brushstrokes define the texture of buildings, trees, and figures.

artworks.title: Village Street
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image displays a rural scene from an elevated viewpoint. A winding dirt path is lined with thatched-roof cottages and trees. The horizon is obscured by the path and more trees, giving the impression of an endless road. The etching technique features fine lines showing detailed textures of the huts and tree leaves. A figure leads livestock, including cows and sheep, along the path. Two figures stand near trees on the left. The road curves past more cottages into the background where trees and their branches create patterns against the sky. The monochrome palette enhances the tranquil and pastoral atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Village Street
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a high horizon, featuring a village with thatched houses and trees. In the foreground, there are figures engaged in activity with a dog. The etching technique is used to create fine, linear strokes for texture and shadow. The color palette is primarily monochromatic with shades of gray and black. The intricate linework highlights the details of the cottages and foliage, creating a balanced composition.
